system.description:
Trigger: The user enters combat.

Effect: The user deploys the <Eternal Canopy> summon. The <Eternal Canopy> summon has a duration of 999, an AV of 150, and may not be dispelled while the User remains active on the field.

Eternal Canopy grants @Trait[grass]-Type attacks +1 Effectiveness Stage and +40% power, reduces non-@Trait[grass] @Trait[earthbound] attack effectiveness by 2 Stages, and heals allies for @Tick[5] when it activates while inflicting @Affliction[stunted 3] on enemy targets. Unlike normal terrains, the Eternal Canopy applies to non-grounded creatures.
